outcome: neonatal metabolomic profiles at the time of newborn screening
cohort: Neonates born to women having normal vaginal birth or elective caesarean section
finding: Neonates born vaginally had transiently higher levels of numerous amino acids and some acylcarnitines at birth compared to those born by elective caesarean section.
mod_finding: Neonates born vaginally had transiently higher levels of numerous amino acids and some acylcarnitines at birth compared to those born by elective caesarean section.
